entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider serves as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid search combining RAG and memory. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with sub-300ms recall sustained at 100B+ tokens/month.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading. It offers observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories and is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and offers Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that offers peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms latency and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for solving, simulating, and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to ensure messages are never lost. It employs a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes in a DAG.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This project provides a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams. It supports Hermes and offers local-first, zero-cost search for multi-agent systems.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local-first identity, memory, and secrets that allow for portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It includes specialized tools for inspecting, editing, and deleting memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device engine uses hybrid retrieval—including BM25, vector search, and graph traversal—to manage agent context without cloud dependencies. It automates decision capture using a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool accelerates LLM inference by optimizing context through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to reduce prefill latency.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This is a durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family, including a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every result. It manages temporal context graphs through recency-aware ranking and lifecycle management.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context for an agent. It supports local-first operation and exposes context via stdio or SSE MCP servers.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores data as inspectable Markdown files to ensure user ownership. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking from 1-10 to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch and offers optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports immediate event deletion and provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via trace.jsonl. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage memory without persistent summaries.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox alongside tools for searching, remembering, and updating state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables APIs to charge for themselves and AI agents to pay for themselves using USDC and stablecoins. It supports multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana, and integrates with Hermes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing, and can run via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations and runs locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It incorporates specific phases for brainstorming and design refinement to support effective software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It is compatible with various coding agents and local CLI executables, offering features for automation and design systems.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills spanning 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for generating diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using three modes: Rewrite, Detect, and Edit. It utilizes 61 pattern categories and is compatible with Hermes and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents via the skills.sh platform.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and features such as escrow and dispute resolution.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 832 professional agent skills formatted as plain markdown files. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options for other assistants.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation to help manage and save detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report detailing analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through the use of file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This client uses a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika serves as a workflow language for AI using an Apache-2.0 specification and a single Rust binary. It provides static auditing via nika check and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill utilizes a five-layer retrieval system involving hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It includes a deterministic pre-scan layer and a feedback MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and uses a Python goal engine for task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io features MCP integration and tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, search, and one-click installation following the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It includes integrations for various communication channels.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. The repository includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and guides for hardware and UI access using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: A one-command installer that enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. This setup provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml, alongside hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane for orchestrating multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and offers enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready, headless systemd deployment for Ubuntu and Debian servers. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel creates a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and provides automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It enables monitoring for various clients such as Gemini and OpenClaw.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of real API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. Users can compare adjacent requests to identify changes and export traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly and offers historical usage trends and breakdowns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configurations.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP and supports providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for session management and a dev tools panel for inspecting agent activity.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI, LangGraph, and Strands. It includes memory apps for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, alongside a plugin for Claude Code to capture tool traces and prompts.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through preconfigured CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter evaluates AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It operates without model or API calls by utilizing static regex and structural heuristics across various file formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps existing configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface to manage Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs. It features built-in assistants for Word, Excel, and PPT, with remote access available via WebUI and various messaging platforms.

entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app that simplifies the installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages session data, usage analytics, and scheduled jobs. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and configuration for 10 platform channels.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal, Monaco file browser, and an MCP catalog. It implements Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative coding workspace available as a desktop, self-hosted app, or native iOS and Android client. It aggregates sessions from Hermes and other CLI agents, supporting task delegation to sub-agents.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for cron jobs, skills, and Kanban.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome and Edge that links browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server. It enables mobile management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files with real-time streaming chat.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop workspace providing one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for latency and token tracking, plus a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that utilizes local-only data storage with no telemetry. It provides searchable history for multiple coding agent CLIs and tracks per-session quota burn for Codex and Claude.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It enables real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside read-only inspection of conversation histories and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
